name: Trusting Man
overview: Scripture clearly warns against placing ultimate trust in man, highlighting that human strength and wisdom are limited and unreliable. The psalmist emphasizes that it is better to trust in the LORD rather than in princes or any son of man, for they offer no true help or salvation. Proverbs reinforces this by urging believers to trust wholeheartedly in the LORD rather than relying on their own understanding or the deceitful inclinations of their hearts. Isaiah calls believers to cease depending on mortal man, whose life is fleeting and insignificant compared to God’s eternal power and faithfulness.
